I am an old man now, 67 years, and I have farmed this land in Mzimba for many years. This maize plot is small but it feeds my household, so I try to get a FISP coupon when I can — this season I managed to get one, so I will put fertilizer on the maize, though I must stretch the bags across the plot. I have some cattle kraal manure from my livestock which I spread where I can, and I intercrop with beans to help the soil. I am getting old so I will rely on my family for most of the work, but I will hire a little ganyu labor for ridging and weeding since my back is not what it was.
